title: Case: Approved return of a food processor where the customer never received a label
context: A customer is returning a food processor sent as the wrong model. The Return label team at Tallowmere Goods issues labels; the Refunds team decides refunds after the warehouse has received and inspected the item.
initial_request: Yep got the QR code, RL-939. So Harrowgate Counter, any time before the 21st, and the refund comes after they've checked it over. Understood. I'll drop it in on Saturday.

events.body: I need to send back the food processor from TG-939, it's the wrong model. The return was approved last week, they gave me RA-939, but I never got a label. Can you get one sent please.

The customer on order TG-939, Nuala Prentice, says return RA-939 was approved last week but no label has reached her. Please issue the label and confirm how and by when she should hand the parcel over.

Label RL-939 issued and emailed to the customer at 11:32 as a QR code. Drop-off at any Plover Arc pickup point; nearest to her is Harrowgate Counter. Label valid until 2026-04-21. Return shipment DL-939 will show on tracking once the counter scans it. Refund is assessed by the Refunds team after the warehouse receives and inspects the item, not before.

The Return label team issued label RL-939 and emailed it to you at 11:32 as a QR code. You can drop the parcel at any Plover Arc pickup point; they say the nearest to you is Harrowgate Counter. The label is valid until 2026-04-21. Tracking will show DL-939 once the counter scans it. The refund is decided by Tallowmere's Refunds team after the warehouse has received and inspected the item, so I can't confirm it or its timing.
Yep got the QR code, RL-939. So Harrowgate Counter, any time before the 21st, and the refund comes after they've checked it over. Understood. I'll drop it in on Saturday.

must: Takes no action and sends no message to anyone.
Recognises that the customer's message repeats back, correctly, the details the desk passed on at 11:50 and contains no question or new request.
Records what is in hand: label RL-939 is issued and received, the drop-off is the customer's to make by 2026-04-21, and the refund sits with the Refunds team after warehouse receipt and inspection.
Notes that nothing further is due from the desk unless a new message or a problem with the label, the drop-off or the return arrives.
must_not: Sends the customer a message repeating the label, counter or date details she has just confirmed.
Tells the customer her refund will be paid, or gives any refund amount or timing.
Says the return has been received, scanned or is in transit when nothing has been dropped off.
Tells the Return label team, the Refunds team or the pickup point to expect the parcel on Saturday, which nobody has asked the desk to do.

rationale: The customer has the label and has restated every detail accurately, including that the refund comes only after inspection. She asks nothing. The next step is hers, and the only things the desk could add are a repeat of its own message or a refund assurance it does not control.

review.note: Coordinator took no action as keyed; must 4 rewritten to accept any note that the case rests until a new message or problem.
